module: Define the system and its compliance boundary

lesson.title: Confirm the high-risk route and record its limits
lesson.summary: Confirm the exact high-risk route, exceptions and applicable regime.

prerequisites.reason: Classification tests the intended purpose. Applicability must first have an EU connection
The provider's record duty needs an actor

blocks: **High-risk classification** has two routes. Article 6(1) requires both an Annex I covered product or safety component and mandatory third-party product conformity assessment. This is an assessment by a legally required independent body, not any voluntarily purchased audit.

Solely non-safety assistance, optimisation or quality control does not qualify as a safety component under 6(1a). Failure endangering health and safety overrides that under 6(1b). Assessment solely for non-health/safety risks does not meet 6(1)(b), under 6(1c).

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 2(2), 6(1)–(4), 8(2); Annexes I and III

blocks: Article 6(2) covers the specific uses in **Annex III**. Read the point, not only a sector heading. Our case stipulates candidate ranking under point 4(a), materially influencing shortlisting, with no established exception.

Article 6(3) requires no significant risk of harm and a qualifying narrow procedural, improvement of completed human work, pattern-review, or preparatory task. The pattern condition preserves proper human review. Annex III profiling of people is always high-risk despite that exception. Profiling means automated personal-data processing evaluating personal aspects.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 2(2), 6(1)–(4), 8(2); Annexes I and III

blocks: **Limited sector applicability** is a distinct boundary. Article 2(2) limits the Act’s application to Annex I Section B systems to the specified provisions: 6(1), 60a and 102–112; Articles 57–59 apply only as integrated into sector law.

Do not automatically copy all Articles 8–27 to Section B. Section A systems instead retain applicable requirements: permitted integration of testing and documentation avoids duplication without waiving duties. Identify the exact Annex entry first.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 2(2), 6(1)–(4), 8(2); Annexes I and III

blocks: A **classification record** links functions and intended purpose to the exact route and evidence. Unknown exception facts do not establish an exemption.

A provider relying on 6(3) documents its assessment before market placement/service, registers under 49(2), and supplies it to authorities on request. Human review alone is not the complete exception test. Record route, Annex point, exception/profiling analysis, sources and owner.

options.blocks: No; the complete exception conditions matter
options.reason: Human involvement alone does not satisfy 6(3).

options.blocks: Yes; human approval always removes high risk
options.reason: Material influence and the statutory tests remain relevant.
